description: Get the full result of one House of Lords vote: the motion or amendment, Content and Not Content totals, whether the government won, the split by party, peers who voted against most of their own party, and every peer listed as Content or Not Content. Answers "which peers voted against the government?". Source: UK Parliament Lords Votes API. Lists return up to 100 peers per side, with party filter and offset for the rest; peers who did not vote are not listed. (cost: 1 credit)

divisionId.description: int, required, Lords division id (division_id from lords_division_search)

limit.description: int, optional, peers listed per side, 1-100, default 100

offset.description: int, optional, skip this many peers in each list for paging, default 0

party.description: string, optional, only list peers of this party or group, e.g. "Crossbench", "Bishops" or "Lab"

name: lords_division_result
